name: Tiger 3
subtitle: Wing pick and roll
goal: A classic pick and roll: 2 and 4 play a two-man game on the wing.
options: Best: 4 on the roll, or 2 scoring off the screen. Nothing? Reverse it and try again.

steps.note: 4 sprints out and screens 2's defender on the inside, between 2 and the basket.
2 drives off the screen toward the lane. 4 rolls straight to the basket.
2 hits 4 on the roll for the layup. If it is not there, reverse the ball and run it on the other side.
